name: Squarespace
description: Ecommerce: website builder with commerce features and REST Commerce APIs (Orders, Inventory, Transactions, Products, Profiles, Webhooks) for merchant sites.
access_notes: Site owners generate API keys self-serve under Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys, but Commerce APIs (Orders, Inventory, Transactions) are only available on higher-tier plans (Commerce Advanced; also Core/Plus/Advanced in the newer lineup) — no free plan or free API tier. Forms API needs Business plan or higher. Multi-site Extensions require registering as an OAuth client via an application form. Keys/tokens are sent as Authorization: Bearer.
mcp_notes: No official Squarespace MCP server found on developers.squarespace.com or the Squarespace blog; no Composio Squarespace toolkit (composio.dev/toolkits/squarespace and docs.composio.dev/toolkits/squarespace return 404).
uncertainty_notes: Searched 'Squarespace MCP server official' and probed Composio toolkit URLs; found nothing vendor-official. API surface is commerce-focused (orders, inventory, transactions, products, profiles) rather than full site management, hence medium breadth. Webhook Subscriptions API requires OAuth tokens; API keys are not supported for webhooks.

evidence.note: Commerce API auth via generated API key or OAuth access token; custom-app API keys require the Commerce Advanced plan; Extensions must use OAuth.
Plan gating: Orders/Inventory/Transactions APIs available on Core, Plus, Advanced and Commerce Advanced plans; Forms API on Business+.
REST requests to api.squarespace.com with Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_OR_OAUTH_TOKEN.
Webhook Subscriptions API exists; 'must authenticate using an OAuth token'.
